PS4_tetrahedron_pattern.interpretation: 5 PS4 tetrahedra all show broken 4-fold symmetry. 4 of 5 have C3v-like (1 unique + 3 equivalent) S charge pattern.

mechanism.structural_origin: Li5.4 vacancy + 1:1 Cl/Br mix = MAX disorder. Li ordering creates asymmetric Li-coordination around each PS4 — 1 S faces Li-rich environment (strong polar P-S), 3 S face vacancy/halogen-rich environment (weak polar, more covalent).
mechanism.electronic_consequence: Charge density redistributes from weak-S basins to P basin — P retains +2 extra e vs comp1/2/modelC P. PS4 bonding becomes more covalent (less ionic).
mechanism.macro_consequence: Weakened ionic Li-S backbone (mean strength proxy q_Li*|q_S|/r_Li-S = 0.469 vs 0.62-0.65 in other comps, ~25% weaker) -> direct microscopic origin of paper #1 comp4 E -9% (Young's modulus deficit).

bader_v2_bimodal_S.paper_1_narrative_VERIFIED: v1 hypothesis ('comp4 PS4 covalent + Li-S backbone weakening = E -9% origin') CONFIRMED by v2 cross-validation. NOT Bader artifact — real frustration unique to 1:1 Cl/Br mix + Li5.4 vacancy.
bader_v2_bimodal_S.next_validation: Test comp3 v2 (Li5.4 Cl1.0/Br0.6) and comp5 v2 (Li5.4 Cl0.6/Br1.0) anneal champion + Bader. If both show low weak% (~5-10% like other comps), comp4 1:1 mix UNIQUELY frustrated. If 30-50%, frustration scales with mix asymmetry.
